preamble: In memory of Albie Fiore, aka 18 across, who died suddenly on 28 July

clue.text: One genius on vacation getting into picture puzzles

indicators.note: getting into says the following pieces go inside the film title

parts.note: Jaws is the Spielberg shark picture
one is I, the Roman numeral

indicators.note: a word on vacation has been emptied, leaving only its outside letters

explanation.surface: A gifted person on holiday gets absorbed in some picture puzzles.
explanation.walkthrough: 'picture puzzles' reads as one phrase, but 'picture' is the film JAWS, which takes in I plus GS (genius emptied by 'on vacation'); 'puzzles' alone defines.
explanation.definitionFit: Jigsaws are cut-up picture puzzles reassembled piece by piece, a plural synonym.

clue.text: I try to conceal pain beginning to play punk rock artist

indicators.note: to conceal means one piece hides the other inside

parts.note: to have a go is to try
gyp is British slang for pain, as in my knee gives me gyp

indicators.note: beginning to picks the first letter of the word

explanation.surface: I try to hide my aches as I start to play like a punk rocker.
explanation.definitionFit: Iggy Pop is the American singer called the Godfather of Punk.

clue.text: OK, for example, thus

parts.note: say is used to introduce an example
so means thus

explanation.surface: OK is an example of something, so they say.
explanation.definitionFit: Say-so is permission or authorisation, which is what an OK gives.

clue.text: 21 area where we were contemptible, British held

indicators.note: held means the word takes in a letter

parts.note: stank means were contemptible or of bad quality

explanation.surface: A trouble spot where we behaved shamefully while the British held control.
explanation.walkthrough: 21 down solves as a puzzle word meaning a trouble spot, so the definition reads as a disputed territory.
explanation.definitionFit: The West Bank is a disputed Palestinian territory, a notorious trouble spot in the Middle East.

clue.text: Bad-tempered 27, left on the interior, heading this way?

indicators.note: on the interior says a piece sits inside the spy's letters

parts.note: 27 across solves as a mole, and a mole is a spy

indicators.note: in an across clue, heading this way (leftwards as one reads back) turns the word round

parts.note: port is the left side of a ship

explanation.surface: A grumpy undercover agent, kept left inside, wonders which way to go.
explanation.walkthrough: '27' points to the MOLE answer, read as a spy; 'heading this way?' turns the left word round, since an across entry read leftwards runs backwards, and 'on the interior' places it inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Stroppy is informal British for bad-tempered and quarrelsome, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Man's written in blue, which is yet to be verified

definitions.text: which is yet to be verified

indicators.note: written in means one piece is set inside another

parts.note: blue is the colour of the UK Conservatives, so a blue is a Tory
he is a man, and 's here just joins

explanation.surface: A man's name appears in blue ink, still unconfirmed.
explanation.walkthrough: Blue is the party colour of Britain's Conservatives, the Tories.
explanation.definitionFit: A theory is an idea or hypothesis not yet proved, something yet to be confirmed.

clue.text: New player filling boots, taking out wingers immediately

indicators.note: filling means going inside another word
the outer letters, wingers, are taken out of the word

parts.note: thesp is short for thespian, an actor or player

explanation.surface: A new player fills the boots of a departed winger right away.
explanation.walkthrough: 'taking out wingers' leaves OOT from BOOTS, and N plus THESP fill it.
explanation.definitionFit: On the spot means at once, without delay, an idiom for immediately.

clue.text: Very cold outside alehouse, not getting first of beers in

indicators.note: outside means the first word goes round the other

parts.note: polar means extremely cold

indicators.note: not getting means the letter is dropped

parts.note: a pub is an alehouse

indicators.note: first of picks the first letter of the word

explanation.surface: Freezing outside, a pub without beer is let in.
explanation.definitionFit: In and popular both mean fashionable and well liked.

clue.text: The new stadium erupts for 18's favourites

indicators.note: erupts sends the letters flying into a new order

explanation.surface: Fans erupt at the new stadium for their club.
explanation.walkthrough: This London football club moved into the former Olympic Stadium; 18 is Taupi, who supported them.
explanation.definitionFit: Albie Fiore supported this East London football club, so they were Taupi's favourites.

clue.text: About to lay Phil Mitchell's mum when papa's away

indicators.note: when papa is away that letter is gone from the name

parts.note: Peggy Mitchell is Phil's mother in the BBC soap EastEnders
papa is P in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A soap matriarch is about to lay into someone while father is out.
explanation.walkthrough: PEGGY Mitchell is Phil's mother in EastEnders, a long-running British TV soap; 'when papa's away' drops the P.
explanation.definitionFit: A hen that is eggy is full of eggs and ready to produce them, a jocular sense.

clue.text: No right cultivating Peter Storey's image

indicators.note: cultivating works the letters over into a new form
no right means one R is left out of the name

parts.note: Peter Storey, a 1970s Arsenal footballer, taken as his letters

explanation.surface: A footballer is building a public image without the right touch.
explanation.walkthrough: Peter Storey was a hard-tackling Arsenal and England footballer; 'No right' removes an R before 'cultivating' rearranges the rest.
explanation.definitionFit: A stereotype is a fixed, oversimplified image of a type of person, a synonym.

clue.text: Place order, getting from pick-up to destination, showing self-possession

indicators.note: the end points of the journey get the inner letters between them

parts.note: a journey from A to B starts at point A, the pick-up
B is the end point in getting from A to B
PL is the abbreviation for place, as in street names
OM is the Order of Merit

explanation.surface: A taxi booking is made, travelling from collection to drop-off with calm confidence.
explanation.walkthrough: 'from pick-up to destination' is the stock phrase 'from A to B', so the journey's end letters frame the place and the order.
explanation.definitionFit: Aplomb is cool self-assurance, a direct synonym for self-possession.

clue.text: What's triple-layered? The answer's somewhat coincidental

indicators.note: the letters only somewhat coincide in order, so they are rearranged

parts.note: a reply is an answer

explanation.surface: Someone asks what has three layers and finds the response a bit of a coincidence.
explanation.walkthrough: THE REPLY and the answer share every letter and nearly their order, only one E shifts, hence 'somewhat coincidental'.
explanation.definitionFit: Three-ply describes wool or tissue made of three layered strands, so it is triple-layered.

clue.text: Quiet? Very nearly that when breaking in on holiday route to Brindisi

indicators.note: breaking in says the pieces burst into the holiday word

parts.note: someone on holiday is away
p is the musical notation for quiet

indicators.note: very nearly means the word lacks its last letter

parts.note: that points back to quiet, which in music is piano

explanation.surface: Wondering whether it is quiet, a holidaymaker on the road south to Brindisi breaks in.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Very nearly that' means piano (quiet) missing its last letter, PIAN; P plus PIAN 'breaking in' AWAY gives the Roman road.
explanation.definitionFit: The Appian Way was the ancient Roman road from Rome running to Brindisi on the Adriatic.

clue.text: Yours truly's offered sweet with little bread, wiping top lip

parts.note: yours truly means I, and with 's for is it gives I'm
pud, short for pudding, is a sweet or dessert

indicators.note: wiping top means the first letter is removed

parts.note: bread is slang for money, and pence are little money

explanation.surface: I'm offered a dessert with a little bread, and wipe my top lip.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bread' is money slang; PENCE is little money, and 'wiping top' drops its P.
explanation.definitionFit: Lip is informal for cheeky backchat, a synonym for insolence.

clue.text: "Games and Puzzles" portfolio covers

indicators.note: the words cover the answer, holding it inside them

explanation.surface: A portfolio of covers from the magazine Games and Puzzles.
explanation.walkthrough: Games and Puzzles was a British magazine that Albie Fiore edited; the run spans the end of 'Puzzles' and start of 'portfolio'.
explanation.definitionFit: Sport and games are synonyms for athletic play and contests.

clue.text: Perfect clothes on a fighter

indicators.note: clothes means wrapping around the following letters

parts.note: in mint condition means perfect
on and lit both describe a light that is switched on

explanation.surface: Perfect clothes are put on a soldier.
explanation.definitionFit: A militant is an aggressive campaigner, one who fights for a cause.

clue.text: Our dear friend up at one, puzzling

indicators.note: puzzling says the letters are jumbled

parts.note: one is I, the Roman numeral

explanation.surface: A beloved friend is up at one o'clock working on a puzzle.
explanation.walkthrough: The preamble says Albie Fiore set as Taupi, the name being defined here.
explanation.definitionFit: Taupi was the setting pseudonym of Albie Fiore, the friend the puzzle remembers.

clue.text: A long time to get over German staying in hotel

indicators.note: staying in means sitting inside the other word

parts.note: an age is a long time
uber is German for over

explanation.surface: A long time to get past a German staying in a hotel.
explanation.definitionFit: An auberge is a French inn, a type of hotel.

clue.text: Car book with copy on cassette

parts.note: Audi is a German car make
OT is the Old Testament, a book of the Bible
to ape is to copy

explanation.surface: A car manual comes with a copy on cassette.
explanation.definitionFit: A cassette is a cartridge of audiotape, a synonym for sound recording on magnetic strip.

clue.text: Puzzle for the scary one to write up

parts.note: pro means for, in favour of

indicators.note: in a down clue, writing up means reading from bottom to top

parts.note: Mel B was Scary Spice of the Spice Girls

explanation.surface: A puzzle for a scary person to write up.
explanation.walkthrough: Scary Spice of the 1990s pop group the Spice Girls was Mel B.
explanation.definitionFit: A problem is a puzzle to be solved, a synonym.

clue.text: Sudden enlightenment emerging from Pisa to Rimini

indicators.note: emerging from says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A traveller crossing Italy from Pisa to Rimini has a sudden revelation.
explanation.definitionFit: Satori is the Zen Buddhist term for a flash of sudden spiritual enlightenment.

clue.text: A friend acquires trimmed skirt in the city

parts.note: bud, short for buddy, is a friend

indicators.note: trimmed means the last letter is cut off

parts.note: a riding habit is a woman's long skirt for horse riding

explanation.surface: A friend gets hold of a shortened skirt in town.
explanation.definitionFit: Abu Dhabi is the capital city of the United Arab Emirates.

clue.text: Hip character recalled jazz openings

parts.note: hip means fashionable, which is in

indicators.note: recalled means called back, so the word runs backwards

parts.note: sort means kind or character, as in a good sort

explanation.surface: A cool figure remembered the opening bars of jazz pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: Intros are the opening passages of jazz numbers before the main tune.

clue.text: Tongue's end circling woman's middle

indicators.note: circling means going round the other piece

parts.note: the tail is the end

indicators.note: middle picks the central letter of the word

explanation.surface: A tongue's tip circles round a woman's waist.
explanation.definitionFit: Tamil is a language of southern India and Sri Lanka; tongue means language.

clue.text: Relative taking drugs behind Burlington House causes no little drama

indicators.note: behind places the first pieces next to the academy in the charade

parts.note: gran is a grandmother, a relative
dope is slang for drugs
Burlington House in London is home of the Royal Academy, RA

explanation.surface: A grandmother caught on drugs at the back of an art gallery causes quite a scene.
explanation.walkthrough: Burlington House on Piccadilly, London, houses the Royal Academy of Arts, RA.
explanation.definitionFit: Grand opera is a large-scale, fully sung serious opera, hence drama that is far from little.

clue.text: Spot the Mexican sauce

definitions.meaning: a spot means a small dark blemish on the skin
a rich Mexican chilli and chocolate sauce has this name

explanation.definitionFit: A mole is a skin spot; also the name of a Mexican chilli sauce.

clue.text: Preacher by lake in daydream

parts.note: Rev, for Reverend, is a preacher
Erie is one of the North American Great Lakes

explanation.surface: A clergyman by the lakeside is lost in a daydream.
explanation.definitionFit: A reverie is a state of pleasant dreamy musing, a synonym.

clue.text: European claiming Egypt's last disembowelled mummy is Cleopatra's daddy

indicators.note: claiming means taking a letter into its middle

parts.note: a Pole is a European

indicators.note: last picks the final letter of the word
disembowelled means the insides are removed, leaving the outer letters

explanation.surface: A European grabs Egypt's last gutted mummy, which turns out to be Cleopatra's father.
explanation.walkthrough: Cleopatra VII was a daughter of Ptolemy XII.
explanation.definitionFit: Cleopatra's father was Ptolemy XII Auletes, a king of the Macedonian dynasty of Egypt.
